meta.title: Desktop Computer Use
meta.description: Gives agents a desktop screenshot tool and real mouse/keyboard control on Windows and Linux/X11 through the computer-use capability.

client._note: Mirror of the Web 「Desktop」 view strings; the zh/en dictionaries in client.js are authoritative, keep both in sync.
client.desktopTraceHint: computer_screenshot and computer calls from this session, grouped by round and reviewable on their own.
client.capOffTitle: Computer use is off for this conversation
client.capOffHint: Turn it on so the agent can use the desktop screenshot and mouse/keyboard tools from its next step. Off by default, and scoped to this conversation.
client.capOnTitle: Computer use is on for this conversation
client.capOnHint: Desktop screenshot and mouse/keyboard tools are available here. Turning it off removes them immediately.
client.capNoSession: No session id, so the computer-use switch cannot be read or written.
